summary: App web questions can be answered by Codex hosted search: a runtime adapter (codex-web-request.mjs) makes one Gateway tools.invoke web_search call and projects Codex's answer and cited links into the closed public Web contract (provider codex, providerAuth account, profile openai:codex-hosted-search, evidenceType codex_citation, no excerpt quote); the Companion validator admits that variant and keeps every other provider unchanged.
reason: Amine 04/11: app web search through Codex alone, Parallel disabled, no fallback, on the existing search card (option 1). Codex hosted search already answers Sol's web turns since core #535.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-codex-web-request.mjs
tests.evidence: 7 node tests, including the verbatim S24 capture of 04/11 (fixtures/codex-web/tools-invoke-web-search-20261104.json: one claim citing NowPrice and CoursPétrole, trailing citation links removed from the text, hosted-search profile since the Gateway reports no model); projection of paragraphs and list items, utm_source removed, unsafe links dropped, five sources max, 1000/4000 character bounds; one web_search call on agent main within the budget; named failures with no sources or claims; closed request contract. Registered in ci.yml.

capabilities.reason: The samantha.app.web.* capabilities, routes and budgets are owned by the playbooks registry (paired PR samantha-ui-playbooks#391), which selects the Codex policy; this repository changes no capability entry.

architecture.reason: Same Graph-owned public Web step, same runtime-script boundary and same validators; the Codex adapter reuses the Gateway's configured web_search provider and the existing openclaw gateway call CLI. No new store, router, scheduler or daemon.

evidence: external_mcp keeps the same samantha.app.web.* capabilities; their result now carries provider codex when the playbooks registry selects it.

limitations: Codex returns no page excerpt: claims are attributed to the links Codex cited (or to its whole source list when a paragraph has no inline link), not to a quoted passage.
The Android app must accept provider codex (paired app PR) before the card renders it; an older app shows the run as invalid web.
Measured on the S24 on 04/11 (load 3.2): 18.7 s end to end through openclaw gateway call, of which 13.3 s inside Codex; within the 30 s public Web budget but with little margin under load.
The Gateway's web_search result does not name the Codex model; the run reports openai/codex-hosted-search.
rollback: Revert the playbooks registry policy to the Parallel/Gemini policy (the parallel-free path is unchanged), then revert this commit.
